mapper.update: UPDATE t_user_coupon SET status = 1, order_id = #{orderId}, used_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
UPDATE t_user_coupon SET status = 0, order_id = NULL, used_time = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1
mapper.select: SELECT uc.id AS userCouponId, ct.id AS templateId, ct.name AS templateName, ct.type AS type, ct.threshold_amount AS thresholdAmount, ct.discount_amount AS templateDiscountAmount, ct.discount_rate AS discountRate, CASE WHEN ct.type = 1 THEN ct.discount_amount WHEN ct.type = 2 THEN #{orderAmount} * (1 - ct.discount_rate) WHEN ct.type = 3 THEN LEAST(ct.discount_amount, #{orderAmount}) END AS discountAmount, #{orderAmount} - ( CASE WHEN ct.type = 1 THEN ct.discount_amount WHEN ct.type = 2 THEN #{orderAmount} * (1 - ct.discount_rate) WHEN ct.type = 3 THEN LEAST(ct.discount_amount, #{orderAmount}) END ) AS finalAmount FROM t_user_coupon uc JOIN t_coupon_template ct ON uc.coupon_template_id = ct.id WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} AND uc.status = 0 AND ct.status = 1 AND ct.end_time > NOW() AND #{orderAmount} >= ct.threshold_amount ORDER BY discountAmount DESC
